# Markets, [measured.]{.grad}

Each question gets a naive baseline to beat, a stated uncertainty, and an honest
answer, including when the answer is "it didn't work".

### [NVIDIA predictor [→]{.arrow}](experiments/nvidia.qmd){.card-link}

down the next day? Tested on two decades of history, then scored daily on calls it
cannot take back.
